title: GrowthBook why-us cards (v2)
description: A big heading, then a narrow tab list (a white active tab with a gradient edge, small mono 'For' prefixes) beside a row of tall gradient cards (navy, violet, teal) with a short white title and an art slot at the bottom. The row slides sideways as you scroll; the tabs switch the set of cards. On phones the tabs become a sideways strip with a violet underline.
notes: needs JavaScript for the tabs (hydrate: visible)
the sideways slide is CSS; without scroll timelines or with reduced motion the row is a plain swipe row
name: growthbook-v2-why
